from AlgorithmImports import *
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, time


class SPYOptionCrossoverAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        # Set backtest parameters
        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)
        self.SetTimeZone(TimeZones.NewYork)

        # Subscribe to SPY Equity with raw price normalization
        equity = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        equity.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw)
        self.spy_symbol = equity.Symbol

        # Subscribe to SPY Options at minute resolution
        option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.option_symbol = option.Symbol
        # Filter: Calls only, 7 to 60 calendar days to expiration, strikes up to +20 strikes OTM
        option.SetFilter(lambda u: u.CallsOnly().Expiration(7, 60).Strikes(-2, 20))

        # 5-minute TradeBar Consolidator aligned to NY clock boundaries
        consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(timedelta(minutes=5))
        consolidator.DataConsolidated += self.OnFiveMinuteBar
        self.SubscriptionManager.AddConsolidator(self.spy_symbol, consolidator)

        # Moving Averages on 5-minute bars
        self.fast_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        # Crossover tracking state
        self.fast_prev = None
        self.slow_prev = None
        self.pending_crossover = False

        # Order and Position state
        self.held_contract = None
        self.entry_fill_price = None
        self.entry_ticket = None
        self.is_entry_pending = False
        self.disabled_until_date = None

    def OnFiveMinuteBar(self, sender, bar):
        # Update SMAs with the 5-minute closing price
        self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        if not (self.fast_sma.IsReady and self.slow_sma.IsReady):
            self.fast_prev = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
            self.slow_prev = self.slow_sma.Current.Value
            return

        fast_curr = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
        slow_curr = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        # Check for bullish crossover
        is_crossover = False
        if self.fast_prev is not None and self.slow_prev is not None:
            is_crossover = (self.fast_prev <= self.slow_prev) and (fast_curr > slow_curr)

        # Store current values for the next bar comparison
        self.fast_prev = fast_curr
        self.slow_prev = slow_curr

        # Check entry time window: crossover bar end time from 09:45 through 14:30 NY time inclusive
        bar_end_time = bar.EndTime.time()
        in_window = (time(9, 45) <= bar_end_time <= time(14, 30))

        if is_crossover and in_window:
            self.pending_crossover = True
            self.Debug(f"Bullish crossover detected at 5-min bar close: {bar.EndTime}")

    def OnData(self, slice):
        # 1. Unexpected Exercise or Assignment Handling
        if self.Portfolio[self.spy_symbol].Invested:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy_symbol, -self.Portfolio[self.spy_symbol].Quantity)
            self.Debug("Unexpected SPY equity position detected (assignment/exercise). Liquidated immediately.")

        # 2. Evaluate Exits for Option Position
        if self.held_contract is not None and self.Portfolio[self.held_contract].Invested:
            expiry_date = self.held_contract.ID.Date.date()

            # Expiration processing fallback (never hold into expiration day)
            if self.Time.date() >= expiry_date:
                self.Debug(f"Expiration processing: Liquidating option {self.held_contract} on/after expiration date.")
                self.Liquidate(self.held_contract)
                self.disabled_until_date = self.Time.date()
                return

            # Time Stop Evaluation (15:45 NY time on trading day preceding contract expiration date)
            if self.IsTimeStopReached(expiry_date):
                self.Debug(f"Time stop reached at {self.Time}. Liquidating option position {self.held_contract}.")
                self.Liquidate(self.held_contract)
                return

            # Profit Target Evaluation (50% profit based on bid-ask midpoint)
            if self.entry_fill_price is not None and self.entry_fill_price > 0:
                quote_bar = slice.QuoteBars.get(self.held_contract)
                if quote_bar is not None and quote_bar.Bid is not None and quote_bar.Ask is not None:
                    bid = quote_bar.Bid.Close
                    ask = quote_bar.Ask.Close
                    if bid > 0 and ask > 0:
                        midpoint = (bid + ask) / 2.0
                        if midpoint >= 1.50 * self.entry_fill_price:
                            self.Debug(f"Profit target hit for {self.held_contract}: Mid {midpoint:.2f} >= 1.5x Fill {self.entry_fill_price:.2f}. Liquidating.")
                            self.Transactions.CancelOpenOrders(self.held_contract)
                            self.Liquidate(self.held_contract)
                            return

        # 3. Evaluate Entry Signal (Once per eligible bar close)
        if self.pending_crossover:
            self.pending_crossover = False
            self.TryEntry(slice)

    def TryEntry(self, slice):
        if self.disabled_until_date == self.Time.date():
            self.Debug("Skipped entry selection: New trades disabled today following expiration processing.")
            return

        if self.is_entry_pending:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry selection: An entry order is already pending.")
            return

        if self.held_contract is not None and self.Portfolio[self.held_contract].Invested:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry selection: An option position is currently held.")
            return

        chain = slice.OptionChains.get(self.option_symbol)
        if not chain:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry selection: Option chain data unavailable in current slice.")
            return

        spy_security = self.Securities[self.spy_symbol]
        if not spy_security.HasData or spy_security.Price <= 0:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry selection: SPY price is invalid.")
            return

        spy_price = spy_security.Price
        target_strike_min = spy_price * 1.01
        min_expiry_date = self.Time.date() + timedelta(days=7)

        # Filter candidates: Calls only, expiry >= 7 calendar days out, strike >= 101% SPY price
        candidates = [
            c for c in chain
            if c.Right == OptionRight.Call
            and c.Expiry.date() >= min_expiry_date
            and c.Strike >= target_strike_min
        ]

        if not candidates:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped entry selection: No matching call contracts found for target strike >= {target_strike_min:.2f} and expiry >= {min_expiry_date}.")
            return

        # Select nearest expiration date >= 7 calendar days out
        nearest_expiry = min(c.Expiry.date() for c in candidates)
        expiry_candidates = [c for c in candidates if c.Expiry.date() == nearest_expiry]

        # Select lowest strike >= 101% SPY price
        lowest_strike = min(c.Strike for c in expiry_candidates)
        strike_candidates = [c for c in expiry_candidates if c.Strike == lowest_strike]

        # Break equal-strike ties by ascending string value of contract Symbol
        selected_contract = sorted(strike_candidates, key=lambda c: str(c.Symbol))[0]

        # Place market order for exactly 1 contract
        self.is_entry_pending = True
        self.entry_ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected_contract.Symbol, 1)
        self.Debug(f"Submitted Market Order for 1 call contract: {selected_contract.Symbol} (Strike: {selected_contract.Strike}, Expiry: {selected_contract.Expiry.date()})")

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent):
        if orderEvent.Status == OrderStatus.Submitted:
            return

        # Check if event belongs to our entry order
        if self.entry_ticket is not None and orderEvent.OrderId == self.entry_ticket.OrderId:
            if orderEvent.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
                self.entry_fill_price = orderEvent.FillPrice
                self.held_contract = orderEvent.Symbol
                self.is_entry_pending = False
                self.Debug(f"Entry Order FILLED: {orderEvent.Symbol} at execution price {orderEvent.FillPrice:.2f}")
            elif orderEvent.Status in [OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid, OrderStatus.Rejected]:
                self.is_entry_pending = False
                self.entry_ticket = None
                self.Debug(f"Entry Order failed with status: {orderEvent.Status}")

        # Update held contract state upon exit completion
        if self.held_contract is not None and orderEvent.Symbol == self.held_contract:
            if not self.Portfolio[self.held_contract].Invested:
                self.held_contract = None
                self.entry_fill_price = None
                self.Debug(f"Exit completed for {orderEvent.Symbol}.")

    def IsTimeStopReached(self, expiry_date):
        # Find the trading day immediately preceding the contract's expiration date
        target_date = expiry_date - timedelta(days=1)
        trading_day = self.TradingCalendar.GetTradingDay(target_date)
        while not trading_day.IsTradingDay:
            target_date -= timedelta(days=1)
            trading_day = self.TradingCalendar.GetTradingDay(target_date)

        current_date = self.Time.date()
        current_time = self.Time.time()

        if current_date > target_date:
            return True
        if current_date == target_date and current_time >= time(15, 45):
            return True

        return False

from AlgorithmImports import *
from datetime import datetime, time, timedelta

class SPYOptionCrossoverAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)
        self.SetTimeZone("America/New_York")

        # Subscribe to SPY equity with minute resolution and raw data normalization
        spy_equity = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Minute, Market.USA, False, 1.0)
        spy_equity.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw)
        self.spy = spy_equity.Symbol

        # Subscribe to SPY options at minute resolution
        option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.option_canonical = option.Symbol
        option.SetFilter(lambda u: u.CallsOnly().Strikes(-5, 50).Expiration(0, 60))

        # Consolidate 5-minute SPY TradeBars aligned to New York clock boundaries
        self.Consolidate(self.spy, timedelta(minutes=5), self.OnFiveMinuteBar)

        # Indicators on 5-minute consolidated closes
        self.fast_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        # State tracking variables
        self.entry_ticket = None
        self.held_contract_symbol = None
        self.entry_price = None
        self.prohibit_entry_date = None

    def OnFiveMinuteBar(self, bar):
        # Capture indicator state prior to updating with the current completed bar
        prev_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value if self.fast_sma.IsReady else None
        prev_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value if self.slow_sma.IsReady else None

        # Update averages with current 5-minute bar close
        self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        curr_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value if self.fast_sma.IsReady else None
        curr_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value if self.slow_sma.IsReady else None

        # Both averages must be ready before testing the signal
        if prev_fast is None or prev_slow is None or not self.fast_sma.IsReady or not self.slow_sma.IsReady:
            return

        # Bullish crossover condition: fast <= slow on preceding completed bar AND fast > slow on current completed bar
        is_crossover = (prev_fast <= prev_slow) and (curr_fast > curr_slow)
        if not is_crossover:
            return

        # Check time window: crossover bar end time must be between 09:45 and 14:30 NY time inclusive
        bar_end_time = bar.EndTime.time()
        if not (time(9, 45) <= bar_end_time <= time(14, 30)):
            return

        # Check entry eligibility
        if self.Time.date() == self.prohibit_entry_date:
            return

        if self.entry_ticket is not None and self.entry_ticket.Status in [OrderStatus.Submitted, OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled]:
            return

        if self.held_contract_symbol is not None and self.Portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].Invested:
            return

        if any(p.Value.Invested for p in self.Portfolio if p.Key.SecurityType == SecurityType.Option):
            return

        # Select target option contract and execute market order
        selected_contract = self.select_contract()
        if selected_contract is not None:
            self.AddOptionContract(selected_contract.Symbol, Resolution.Minute)
            self.entry_ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected_contract.Symbol, 1)
            self.held_contract_symbol = selected_contract.Symbol
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Bullish crossover at 5-min bar end {bar.EndTime.strftime('%H:%M')}. "
                       f"Fast SMA: {curr_fast:.2f}, Slow SMA: {curr_slow:.2f}. "
                       f"Submitted market order for 1 contract of {selected_contract.Symbol}")

    def select_contract(self):
        slice_data = self.CurrentSlice
        if slice_data is None or slice_data.OptionChains.Count == 0:
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Entry skipped - Option chain empty in current Slice.")
            return None

        if not self.Securities.ContainsKey(self.spy) or self.Securities[self.spy].Price <= 0:
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Entry skipped - SPY price unavailable.")
            return None

        spy_price = self.Securities[self.spy].Price
        target_strike_min = 1.01 * spy_price
        current_date = self.Time.date()

        chain = None
        for canonical_symbol, option_chain in slice_data.OptionChains.items():
            if canonical_symbol.Canonical == self.option_canonical or canonical_symbol == self.option_canonical:
                chain = option_chain
                break

        if chain is None:
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Entry skipped - SPY option chain not found.")
            return None

        # Filter calls with >= 7 calendar days to expiration and strike >= 101% of current SPY price
        eligible_contracts = []
        for contract in chain:
            if contract.Right != OptionRight.Call:
                continue
            days_to_exp = (contract.Expiry.date() - current_date).days
            if days_to_exp < 7:
                continue
            if contract.Strike < target_strike_min:
                continue
            eligible_contracts.append(contract)

        if not eligible_contracts:
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Entry skipped - No call contract >= 7 DTE and strike >= 101% of SPY price ({spy_price:.2f}).")
            return None

        # Nearest expiration date at least 7 calendar days away
        min_exp = min(c.Expiry.date() for c in eligible_contracts)
        same_exp_contracts = [c for c in eligible_contracts if c.Expiry.date() == min_exp]

        # Lowest strike >= 101% SPY price, tie-break by ascending string value of contract Symbol
        selected = min(same_exp_contracts, key=lambda c: (c.Strike, str(c.Symbol)))
        return selected

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent):
        if orderEvent.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
            # Record filled entry price from order fill event
            if self.entry_ticket is not None and orderEvent.OrderId == self.entry_ticket.OrderId:
                self.entry_price = orderEvent.FillPrice
                self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Entry fill recorded at {self.entry_price:.2f} for {orderEvent.Symbol}")

    def OnData(self, slice):
        # Liquidate unexpected SPY equity position from exercise/assignment immediately
        if self.Portfolio[self.spy].Invested:
            self.Liquidate(self.spy)
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Liquidated unexpected SPY equity position from exercise/assignment.")

        # Exit evaluation on each minute Slice for held option position
        if self.held_contract_symbol is not None and self.Portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].Invested:
            expiry_date = self.held_contract_symbol.ID.Date.date()
            current_date = self.Time.date()

            # Prevent holding contract into expiration date
            if current_date >= expiry_date:
                self.Liquidate(self.held_contract_symbol)
                self.prohibit_entry_date = current_date
                self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Expiration processing reached for {self.held_contract_symbol}. Liquidated position.")
                self.ResetPositionState()
                return

            # Scheduled time stop: 15:45 NY time on trading day immediately preceding contract expiration
            if self.Time.hour == 15 and self.Time.minute == 45:
                if self.is_preceding_trading_day(current_date, expiry_date):
                    self.Liquidate(self.held_contract_symbol)
                    self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Scheduled time stop exit triggered at 15:45 NY time for {self.held_contract_symbol}.")
                    self.ResetPositionState()
                    return

            # Profit target check: 50% profit target based on bid/ask midpoint
            if self.entry_price is not None and self.entry_price > 0:
                if slice.QuoteBars.ContainsKey(self.held_contract_symbol):
                    quote = slice.QuoteBars[self.held_contract_symbol]
                    if quote.Bid is not None and quote.Ask is not None:
                        bid = quote.Bid.Close
                        ask = quote.Ask.Close
                        if bid > 0 and ask > 0:
                            mid = (bid + ask) / 2.0
                            if mid >= 1.50 * self.entry_price:
                                self.Liquidate(self.held_contract_symbol)

                    ask = contract.AskPrice

        has_trading_day = any(td.IsTradingDay for td in trading_days)

        self.entry_price = None
        self.held_contract_symbol = None
        self.no_entry_today = None

        """Processes each completed 5-minute SPY TradeBar."""
        self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        if not self.fast_sma.IsReady or not self.slow_sma.IsReady:
            self.prev_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
            self.prev_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value
            return

        curr_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
        curr_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        # Bullish crossover: Fast <= Slow on previous bar AND Fast > Slow on current bar
        is_crossover = (self.prev_fast is not None and self.prev_slow is not None and 
                        self.prev_fast <= self.prev_slow and curr_fast > curr_slow)

        self.prev_fast = curr_fast
        self.prev_slow = curr_slow

        # Check eligibility window: crossover bar ends from 09:45 through 14:30 NY time inclusive
        bar_end_time = bar.EndTime.time()
        within_window = time(9, 45) <= bar_end_time <= time(14, 30)

        if is_crossover and within_window:
            if self.no_entry_today == self.Time.date():
                self.Debug(f"Skipping entry on {self.Time.date()}: position held into expiration day.")
                return

            if not self.HasOptionPositionOrOpenOrder():
                self.TryExecuteEntry()

        """Inspects option chain and places entry market order for the target call contract."""
        slice_data = self.CurrentSlice
        if slice_data is None or slice_data.OptionChains is None:
            self.Debug("Skipped selection: Option chain slice not available.")
            return

        chain = slice_data.OptionChains.GetValue(self.option_symbol)
        if chain is None:
            # Fallback search in slice option chains
            for canonical, option_chain in slice_data.OptionChains.items():
                if canonical.Underlying == self.spy_symbol:

                    break

            self.Debug("Skipped selection: Invalid SPY price.")

            c for c in chain 
            if c.Right == OptionRight.Call and (c.Expiry.date() - curr_date).days >= 7
        ]

        if not valid_calls:
            self.Debug("Skipped selection: No call contracts with DTE >= 7 calendar days.")
            return

        min_dte = min((c.Expiry.date() - curr_date).days for c in valid_calls)

            c for c in valid_calls if (c.Expiry.date() - curr_date).days == min_dte

        # Check for unexpected SPY equity position from exercise/assignment and liquidate immediately

            self.MarketOrder(self.spy_symbol, -qty)
            self.Debug(f"Liquidated unexpected SPY equity position: {qty} shares.")

        for kvp in self.Portfolio:
            symbol = kvp.Key
            holding = kvp.Value
            if symbol.SecurityType == SecurityType.Option and holding.Invested:
                if symbol.ID.Date.date() <= self.Time.date():
                    self.MarketOrder(symbol, -holding.Quantity)
                    self.no_entry_today = self.Time.date()
                    self.Debug(f"Liquidated option {symbol} remaining at expiration start. Blocked replacement entries for today.")

            expiry_date = self.held_contract_symbol.ID.Date.date()

            # Time stop: 15:45 NY time on the trading day immediately preceding the contract expiration date
            if self.Time.hour == 15 and self.Time.minute == 45:
                if self.IsTradingDayBeforeExpiry(self.Time.date(), expiry_date):
                    qty = self.Portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].Quantity
                    self.MarketOrder(self.held_contract_symbol, -qty)
                    self.Debug(f"Time stop exit triggered at 15:45 on day before expiry for {self.held_contract_symbol}.")
                    self.ResetPositionState()
                    return

            # Profit target check: 50% profit target (midpoint >= 1.50 * entry price)
            sec = self.Securities.GetValueOrDefault(self.held_contract_symbol)
            if sec is not None:
                bid = sec.BidPrice
                ask = sec.AskPrice
                if bid > 0 and ask > 0:
                    midpoint = (bid + ask) / 2.0
                    if self.entry_price is not None and midpoint >= 1.50 * self.entry_price:
                        qty = self.Portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].Quantity
                        self.MarketOrder(self.held_contract_symbol, -qty)
                        self.Debug(f"Profit target reached for {self.held_contract_symbol}: Midpoint {midpoint:.2f} >= 1.50 * Entry {self.entry_price:.2f}. Liquidating.")
                        self.ResetPositionState()

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent: OrderEvent) -> None:
        """Records filled entry prices and logs order updates."""
        if orderEvent.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
            if self.entry_order_ticket is not None and orderEvent.OrderId == self.entry_order_ticket.OrderId:
                self.entry_price = orderEvent.FillPrice
                self.held_contract_symbol = orderEvent.Symbol
                self.Debug(f"Entry filled for {orderEvent.Symbol} at fill price {self.entry_price:.2f}.")

    def OnAssignment(self, assignmentEvent: AssignmentEvent) -> None:
        """Logs option assignment events."""
        self.Debug(f"Unexpected option assignment event for {assignmentEvent.Symbol}: {assignmentEvent.Quantity} contracts.")

    def HasOptionPositionOrOpenOrder(self) -> bool:
        """Checks if an option position is held or an entry order is currently open."""
        if self.entry_order_ticket is not None and self.entry_order_ticket.Status in [
            OrderStatus.New, OrderStatus.Submitted, OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled
        ]:
            return True

        for kvp in self.Portfolio:
            if kvp.Key.SecurityType == SecurityType.Option and kvp.Value.Quantity != 0:
                return True
        return False

    def IsTradingDayBeforeExpiry(self, current_date: datetime.date, expiry_date: datetime.date) -> bool:
        """Determines if current_date is the trading day immediately preceding contract expiry date."""
        if current_date >= expiry_date:
            return False
        
        trading_days = self.TradingCalendar.GetTradingDays(current_date + timedelta(days=1), expiry_date)
        remaining_trading_days = [d for d in trading_days if d.IsTradingDay]
        return len(remaining_trading_days) <= 1

    def ResetPositionState(self) -> None:
        """Resets tracking parameters for position state."""
        self.entry_order_ticket = None
        self.entry_price = None
        self.held_contract_symbol = None

        """Determines if current algorithm date is the trading day immediately preceding expiration."""
        exp_date = symbol.ID.Date.date()
        curr_date = self.Time.date()

        if curr_date >= exp_date:
            return True

        # Check if any trading days exist between current date and expiration date

            self.TradingCalendar.GetTradingDays(
                curr_date + timedelta(days=1), exp_date - timedelta(days=1)
            )
        )

            td.IsTradingDay for td in trading_days

                self.held_contract = None
                self.entry_fill_price = None
                self.entry_order_ticket = None

        """Returns True if current_date is the trading day immediately preceding expiry_date."""
        if current_date >= expiry_date:

        next_day = current_date + timedelta(days=1)

from AlgorithmImports import *
import datetime


class SPYOptionCrossoverAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2023, 4, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2026, 6, 30)
        self.set_cash(100000)
        self.set_time_zone(TimeZones.NEW_YORK)

        # SPY Equity (Minute resolution, Raw price data)
        spy = self.add_equity("SPY", Resolution.MINUTE, DataNormalizationMode.RAW)
        self.spy_symbol = spy.symbol

        # SPY Options subscription (Minute resolution)
        option = self.add_option("SPY", Resolution.MINUTE)
        self.option_symbol = option.symbol
        # Broad filter: Calls only, strikes from ATM to +20 strikes OTM, DTE from 7 to 60 days
        option.set_filter(lambda u: u.calls_only().strikes(0, 20).expiration(7, 60))

        # Moving Averages on 5-minute bars
        self.fast_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        # State tracking for moving averages
        self.prev_fast = None
        self.prev_slow = None

        # State tracking for orders and holdings
        self.held_contract = None
        self.entry_price = None
        self.entry_order_id = None
        self.is_entry_order_open = False
        self.no_new_entries_today = False
        self.last_day = None

        # 5-minute bar consolidator aligned to New York clock boundaries
        consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(timedelta(minutes=5))
        consolidator.data_consolidated += self.on_five_minute_bar
        self.subscription_manager.add_consolidator(self.spy_symbol, consolidator)

    def on_five_minute_bar(self, sender: object, bar: TradeBar) -> None:
        """Processes completed 5-minute SPY TradeBars."""
        # Update indicators with the 5-minute closing price
        self.fast_sma.update(bar.end_time, bar.close)
        self.slow_sma.update(bar.end_time, bar.close)

        # Wait until both moving averages are ready
        if not (self.fast_sma.is_ready and self.slow_sma.is_ready):
            self.prev_fast = self.fast_sma.current.value
            self.prev_slow = self.slow_sma.current.value
            return

        fast_curr = self.fast_sma.current.value
        slow_curr = self.slow_sma.current.value

        # Test bullish crossover condition
        crossover = False
        if self.prev_fast is not None and self.prev_slow is not None:
            if self.prev_fast <= self.prev_slow and fast_curr > slow_curr:
                crossover = True

        # Store values for the next completed bar evaluation
        self.prev_fast = fast_curr
        self.prev_slow = slow_curr

        if not crossover:
            return

        # Check time restriction: Crossover bar end time must be between 09:45 and 14:30 NY time (inclusive)
        bar_time = bar.end_time.time()
        if not (datetime.time(9, 45) <= bar_time <= datetime.time(14, 30)):
            return

        # Ensure no existing position, open entry order, or restriction flag for today
        if self.no_new_entries_today:
            return

        if self.held_contract is not None or self.is_entry_order_open or self.portfolio.invested:
            return

        # Evaluate entry immediately after the eligible 5-minute bar closes
        self.execute_entry(bar.close)

    def execute_entry(self, spy_price: float) -> None:
        """Selects the target call option contract and submits a market buy order."""
        slice_data = self.current_slice
        if slice_data is None or not slice_data.option_chains.contains_key(self.option_symbol):
            self.debug(f"Skipped selection: Option chain missing at {self.time}")
            return

        chain = slice_data.option_chains[self.option_symbol]
        curr_date = self.time.date()

        # Filter option contracts
        candidates = []
        for contract in chain:
            if contract.right != OptionRight.CALL:
                continue

            # Expiration must be at least 7 calendar days after current algorithm date
            dte = (contract.expiry.date() - curr_date).days
            if dte < 7:
                continue

            # Lowest strike >= 101% of current SPY price (1% OTM)
            if contract.strike < 1.01 * spy_price:
                continue

            candidates.append(contract)

        if not candidates:
            self.debug(f"Skipped selection: No eligible call contract at {self.time} (SPY price: {spy_price:.2f})")
            return

        # Select nearest expiration
        min_expiry = min(c.expiry.date() for c in candidates)
        expiry_filtered = [c for c in candidates if c.expiry.date() == min_expiry]

        # Select lowest strike
        min_strike = min(c.strike for c in expiry_filtered)
        strike_filtered = [c for c in expiry_filtered if c.strike == min_strike]

        # Break tie by ascending string value of contract Symbol
        strike_filtered.sort(key=lambda c: str(c.symbol))
        selected_contract = strike_filtered[0]

        # Submit market order for 1 contract
        self.debug(f"Entry Triggered: Buying 1 contract of {selected_contract.symbol} at {self.time}")
        ticket = self.market_order(selected_contract.symbol, 1)
        self.entry_order_id = ticket.order_id
        self.is_entry_order_open = True

    def on_order_event(self, order_event: OrderEvent) -> None:
        """Tracks order fills and records the entry price."""
        if order_event.status == OrderStatus.FILLED:
            if order_event.order_id == self.entry_order_id:
                self.entry_price = order_event.fill_price
                self.held_contract = order_event.symbol
                self.is_entry_order_open = False
                self.debug(f"Entry FILLED: {self.held_contract} at {self.entry_price:.2f} on {self.time}")
            elif self.held_contract is not None and order_event.symbol == self.held_contract:
                if not self.portfolio[self.held_contract].invested:
                    self.debug(f"Exit FILLED: {order_event.symbol} at {order_event.fill_price:.2f} on {self.time}")
                    self.held_contract = None
                    self.entry_price = None

        elif order_event.status in [OrderStatus.CANCELED, OrderStatus.INVALID, OrderStatus.REJECTED]:
            if order_event.order_id == self.entry_order_id:
                self.debug(f"Entry Order Failed: Status {order_event.status} on {self.time}")
                self.is_entry_order_open = False
                self.entry_order_id = None

    def on_data(self, slice_data: Slice) -> None:
        """Evaluates exits on each minute slice and handles edge cases."""
        # Reset daily entry block at the start of a new day
        if self.last_day != self.time.date():
            self.last_day = self.time.date()
            self.no_new_entries_today = False

        # Unexpected SPY equity position cleanup (e.g. from exercise/assignment)
        if self.portfolio[self.spy_symbol].invested:
            self.debug(f"Unexpected SPY equity position detected on {self.time}. Liquidating equity position.")
            self.liquidate(self.spy_symbol)
            self.no_new_entries_today = True

        if self.held_contract is None:
            return

        # Synchronize portfolio state
        if not self.portfolio[self.held_contract].invested and not self.is_entry_order_open:
            self.held_contract = None
            self.entry_price = None
            return

        expiry_date = self.held_contract.id.date.date()

        # Emergency exit: Avoid holding through expiration
        if self.time.date() >= expiry_date:
            self.debug(f"Expiration day safeguard triggered for {self.held_contract} on {self.time}. Liquidating.")
            self.liquidate(self.held_contract)
            self.held_contract = None
            self.entry_price = None
            self.no_new_entries_today = True
            return

        # Scheduled Time Stop: 15:45 NY time on trading day immediately preceding expiration date
        if self.is_preceding_trading_day(expiry_date) and self.time.hour == 15 and self.time.minute == 45:
            self.debug(f"Time Exit: Liquidating {self.held_contract} at 15:45 prior to expiration date {expiry_date}")
            self.liquidate(self.held_contract)
            self.held_contract = None
            self.entry_price = None
            return

        # Profit Target Evaluation (50% profit based on midpoint of strictly positive bid and ask)
        if self.entry_price is not None and self.entry_price > 0:
            bid = 0.0
            ask = 0.0

            self.Debug(f"Skipped selection: No expirations >= 7 calendar days out at {self.Time}")
            return

        target_expiry = min(valid_expiries)

        # Filter for Calls in that expiration with strike >= 101% of current SPY price
        target_strike_min = current_spy_price * 1.01
        eligible_calls = [
            c for c in chain
            if c.Expiry.date() == target_expiry
            and c.Right == OptionRight.Call
            and c.Strike >= target_strike_min
        ]

        if not eligible_calls:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped selection: No call contracts >= 101% OTM for expiry {target_expiry}")
            return

        # Select lowest strike >= 101% OTM; break equal-strike tie by ascending Symbol string
        min_strike = min(c.Strike for c in eligible_calls)
        strike_matches = [c for c in eligible_calls if c.Strike == min_strike]
        selected_contract = sorted(strike_matches, key=lambda c: str(c.Symbol))[0]

        # Submit immediate market order for 1 contract
        self.entry_ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected_contract.Symbol, 1)
        self.Debug(f"Entry order submitted: 1 Call {selected_contract.Symbol} (Strike: {selected_contract.Strike}, Expiry: {selected_contract.Expiry.date()})")

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent):
        # Capture filled entry price upon order completion
        if orderEvent.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
            if self.entry_ticket is not None and orderEvent.OrderId == self.entry_ticket.OrderId:
                self.entry_fill_price = orderEvent.FillPrice
                self.held_option_symbol = orderEvent.Symbol
                self.Debug(f"Entry Filled: {orderEvent.Symbol} at price {self.entry_fill_price:.2f}")
                self.entry_ticket = None

        # Clean up equity positions if exercise/assignment occurs
        if orderEvent.Symbol.SecurityType == SecurityType.Equity and orderEvent.Symbol == self.spy_symbol:
            if self.Portfolio[self.spy_symbol].Invested:
                self.Liquidate(self.spy_symbol)
                self.Debug(f"Unexpected SPY equity position from order event liquidated at {self.Time}")

    def IsPrecedingTradingDay(self, current_date, expiry_date):
        """Checks if current_date is the trading day immediately preceding expiry_date."""
        if current_date >= expiry_date:
            return False
        check_date = current_date + timedelta(days=1)
        hours = self.Securities[self.spy_symbol].Exchange.Hours
        while check_date < expiry_date:
            if hours.IsDateOpen(check_date):
                return False
            check_date += timedelta(days=1)
        return True

        while check_date < expiry_date:
            if hours.IsDateOpen(check_date):

from AlgorithmImports import *
from datetime import time, timedelta

class SPYCallOptionCrossoverStrategy(QCAlgorithm):
    """
    QuantConnect LEAN Algorithm
    Strategy: SPY 5-minute SMA Crossover Options Strategy (Call Only)
    Backtest Period: April 1, 2023 - June 30, 2026
    """

    def Initialize(self):
        # Set Backtest Parameters
        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)
        self.SetTimeZone(TimeZones.NewYork)

        # Add SPY Equity Data (Minute resolution, Raw price)
        equity = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Minute, Market.USA, False, 1)
        equity.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw)
        self.spy_symbol = equity.Symbol

        # Add SPY Option Data (Minute resolution)
        option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.option_symbol = option.Symbol
        # Filter universe: Calls only, DTE 7 to 60 days, 0 to 40 strikes above ATM
        option.SetFilter(lambda u: u.CallsOnly().Strikes(-2, 40).Expiration(7, 60))

        # Setup 5-minute TradeBar Consolidator aligned to NY clock boundaries
        self.consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5))
        self.consolidator.DataConsolidated += self.OnFiveMinuteBar
        self.SubscriptionManager.AddConsolidator(self.spy_symbol, self.consolidator)

        # Define Moving Averages (5-bar and 20-bar SMAs of 5-minute closes)
        self.fast_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        # Historical SMA values for crossover tracking
        self.prev_fast = None
        self.prev_slow = None

        # State Variables
        self.entry_fill_price = None
        self.held_contract_symbol = None
        self.entry_order_ticket = None
        self.expiration_liquidation_date = None

    def OnFiveMinuteBar(self, sender, bar):
        """
        Consolidated 5-minute TradeBar handler.
        Evaluates fast/slow SMA crossover and triggers entry signal.
        Missing bars are naturally skipped without updating the SMAs.
        """
        was_ready = self.slow_sma.IsReady

        # Capture SMA values before updating with the current bar
        p_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value if was_ready else None
        p_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value if was_ready else None

        # Update SMAs with current completed 5-minute bar close
        self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        if not self.slow_sma.IsReady:
            return

        c_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
        c_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        if not was_ready:
            # First bar where SMAs became ready; record values and wait for next bar
            return

        # Bullish Crossover: Fast <= Slow on t-1 AND Fast > Slow on t
        crossover = (p_fast <= p_slow) and (c_fast > c_slow)

        # Check entry window: bar ends between 09:45 and 14:30 NY time, inclusive
        bar_end_time = bar.EndTime.time()
        in_entry_window = (time(9, 45) <= bar_end_time <= time(14, 30))

        if crossover and in_entry_window:
            self.Debug(f"Bullish Crossover at {bar.EndTime}: Fast={c_fast:.2f}, Slow={c_slow:.2f}")
            self.EvaluateEntry(bar.Close)

    def EvaluateEntry(self, current_spy_price):
        """
        Executes entry logic if conditions are met.
        """
        # Block replacement entry on the same day an expiration liquidation occurred
        if self.expiration_liquidation_date == self.Time.date():
            self.Debug("Entry Skipped: Expiration liquidation occurred today.")
            return

        # Do not submit entry if an option position exists or an entry order is open
        if self.IsPositionOrOrderActive():
            self.Debug("Entry Skipped: Active option position or open order exists.")
            return

        # Inspect current option chain slice
        if not self.CurrentSlice or not self.CurrentSlice.OptionChains.ContainsKey(self.option_symbol):
            self.Debug("Entry Skipped: Option chain not delivered in CurrentSlice.")
            return

        chain = self.CurrentSlice.OptionChains[self.option_symbol]
        current_date = self.Time.date()

        # Filter candidate contracts:
        # 1. Calls only
        # 2. DTE >= 7 calendar days after current algorithm date
        # 3. Strike >= 101% of current SPY price
        valid_contracts = []
        for contract in chain:
            if contract.Right != OptionRight.Call:
                continue
            dte = (contract.Expiry.date() - current_date).days
            if dte < 7:
                continue
            if contract.Strike >= 1.01 * current_spy_price:
                valid_contracts.append(contract)

        if not valid_contracts:
            self.Debug("Entry Skipped: No matching call contracts found (DTE >= 7, Strike >= 101% SPY).")
            return

        # Find nearest expiration date >= 7 calendar days
        min_dte = min((c.Expiry.date() - current_date).days for c in valid_contracts)
        target_expiration_contracts = [
            c for c in valid_contracts if (c.Expiry.date() - current_date).days == min_dte
        ]

        # Within nearest expiration, select lowest strike >= 101% of current SPY price
        min_strike = min(c.Strike for c in target_expiration_contracts)
        lowest_strike_contracts = [
            c for c in target_expiration_contracts if c.Strike == min_strike
        ]

        # Tie-breaker: ascending string value of contract Symbol
        selected_contract = sorted(lowest_strike_contracts, key=lambda c: str(c.Symbol))[0]

        # Submit immediate market order for 1 contract
        self.Debug(f"Submitting Entry Order: Buy 1 Call {selected_contract.Symbol} | "
                   f"Strike: {selected_contract.Strike} | Expiry: {selected_contract.Expiry.date()} | "
                   f"SPY Spot: {current_spy_price:.2f}")

        self.entry_order_ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected_contract.Symbol, 1)

    def IsPositionOrOrderActive(self):
        """
        Checks if any option position is currently held or if any orders are open.
        """
        for kvp in self.Portfolio:
            symbol = kvp.Key
            holding = kvp.Value
            if symbol.SecurityType == SecurityType.Option and holding.Invested:
                return True

        open_orders = self.Transactions.GetOpenOrders()
        if len(open_orders) > 0:
            return True

        return False

    def OnData(self, slice):
        """
        Evaluated on each minute Slice for equity assignment checks and option exit rules.
        """
        # 1. Immediate safeguard against unexpected SPY equity positions (from assignment/exercise)
        if self.Portfolio[self.spy_symbol].Invested:
            self.Debug("Unexpected SPY equity position detected. Liquidating immediately.")
            self.Liquidate(self.spy_symbol, tag="Liquidate Equity Assignment")
            return

        # 2. Evaluate exits for active option holdings
        if self.held_contract_symbol and self.Portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].Invested:
            contract_symbol = self.held_contract_symbol
            exp_date = contract_symbol.ID.Date.date()
            current_date = self.Time.date()

            # Expiration Safety Check: Liquidate if reached expiration date boundary
            if current_date >= exp_date:
                self.Debug(f"Expiration processing safeguard reached for {contract_symbol}. Liquidating.")
                self.CancelOpenExitOrders(contract_symbol)
                self.Liquidate(contract_symbol, tag="Expiration Safeguard Exit")
                self.expiration_liquidation_date = current_date
                return

            # Time Stop Check: 15:45 NY time on trading day immediately preceding contract expiration
            if self.Time.hour == 15 and self.Time.minute == 45:
                if self.IsPrecedingTradingDay(current_date, exp_date):
                    self.Debug(f"Time Stop Triggered (15:45 day before expiration) for {contract_symbol}. Liquidating.")
                    self.CancelOpenExitOrders(contract_symbol)
                    self.Liquidate(contract_symbol, tag="Time Stop Exit")
                    return

            # Profit Target Check (50% profit target)
            if self.entry_fill_price and self.entry_fill_price > 0:

        self.entry_fill_price = None
        self.held_contract_symbol = None
        self.entry_order_ticket = None
        self.expiration_liquidation_date = None

    def OnFiveMinuteBar(self, sender, bar):
        """
        Consolidated 5-minute TradeBar handler.
        Evaluates fast/slow SMA crossover and triggers entry signal.
        Missing bars are naturally skipped without updating the SMAs.
        """
        was_ready = self.slow_sma.IsReady

        # Capture SMA values before updating with the current bar
        p_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value if was_ready else None
        p_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value if was_ready else None

        # Update SMAs with current completed 5-minute bar close
        self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        if not self.slow_sma.IsReady:
            return

        c_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
        c_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        if not was_ready:
            # First bar where SMAs became ready; record values and wait for next bar
            return

        # Bullish Crossover: Fast <= Slow on t-1 AND Fast > Slow on t
        crossover = (p_fast <= p_slow) and (c_fast > c_slow)

        # Check entry window: bar ends between 09:45 and 14:30 NY time, inclusive
        bar_end_time = bar.EndTime.time()
        in_entry_window = (time(9, 45) <= bar_end_time <= time(14, 30))

        if crossover and in_entry_window:
            self.Debug(f"Bullish Crossover at {bar.EndTime}: Fast={c_fast:.2f}, Slow={c_slow:.2f}")
            self.EvaluateEntry(bar.Close)

        if self.IsPositionOrOrderActive():

        if not self.CurrentSlice or not self.CurrentSlice.OptionChains.ContainsKey(self.option_symbol):

        # 3. Strike >= 101% of current SPY price

        for contract in chain:

            dte = (contract.Expiry.date() - current_date).days
            if dte < 7:

            if contract.Strike >= 1.01 * current_spy_price:

            self.Debug("Entry Skipped: No matching call contracts found (DTE >= 7, Strike >= 101% SPY).")
            return

        min_dte = min((c.Expiry.date() - current_date).days for c in valid_contracts)
        target_expiration_contracts = [
            c for c in valid_contracts if (c.Expiry.date() - current_date).days == min_dte
        ]

        ]

                    self.held_contract_symbol = None
                    self.entry_fill_price = 0.0
                    self.entry_ticket = None
                    self.pending_entry = False

    def IsPrecedingTradingDay(self, current_date, expiry_date):
        """Check if current_date is the trading day immediately preceding expiry_date."""
        if current_date >= expiry_date:
            return False

        trading_days = self.TradingCalendar.GetTradingDays(current_date, expiry_date)
        valid_days = [d.Date.date() for d in trading_days if d.IsTradingDay and d.Date.date() < expiry_date]
        if not valid_days:
            return False

        return current_date == max(valid_days)

        """Check if any option position currently exists."""
        if self.held_contract_symbol is not None and self.Portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].Invested:
            return True
        for k, v in self.Portfolio.items():
            if k.SecurityType == SecurityType.Option and v.Invested:
                return True
        return False

class SPYOptionCrossoverAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

        )

        self.consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(timedelta(minutes=5))
        self.consolidator.data_consolidated += self.on_five_minute_bar
        self.subscription_manager.add_consolidator(

        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        self.prev_slow = None

        self.is_pending_entry = False
        self.pending_contract_symbol = None
        self.held_contract = None
        self.entry_price = None
        self.blacklisted_date = None

        # 7. Schedule Time Stop Evaluation at 15:45 NY time every trading day
        self.schedule.on(
            self.date_rules.every_day(self.spy_symbol),
            self.time_rules.at(15, 45),
            self.check_time_stop,
        )

        # Warm up moving averages from requested backtest period
        self.set_warm_up(timedelta(days=7))

    def on_five_minute_bar(self, sender: object, bar: TradeBar) -> None:
        """Processes each completed 5-minute SPY TradeBar."""
        # Update SMAs with 5-minute closing prices
        self.fast_sma.update(bar.end_time, bar.close)
        self.slow_sma.update(bar.end_time, bar.close)

        if not self.fast_sma.is_ready or not self.slow_sma.is_ready:
            return

        curr_fast = self.fast_sma.current.value
        curr_slow = self.slow_sma.current.value

        if self.is_warming_up:
            self.prev_fast = curr_fast
            self.prev_slow = curr_slow
            return

        # Check for bullish crossover: fast <= slow previously, fast > slow currently
        if self.prev_fast is not None and self.prev_slow is not None:
            is_crossover = (self.prev_fast <= self.prev_slow) and (
                curr_fast > curr_slow
            )
            bar_time = bar.end_time.time()
            in_window = time(9, 45) <= bar_time <= time(14, 30)

            if is_crossover and in_window:
                self.signal_entry = True
                self.debug(
                    f"Bullish crossover detected at {bar.end_time}. Fast: {curr_fast:.2f}, Slow: {curr_slow:.2f}"
                )

        self.prev_fast = curr_fast
        self.prev_slow = curr_slow

        # 1. Immediately handle unexpected equity position from exercise/assignment

                self.entry_price = None

                            self.entry_price = None

        """Selects target contract and submits market order if entry criteria met."""
        # Do not enter if today is blacklisted from expiration liquidation, or if holding/pending
        if self.blacklisted_date == self.time.date():
            self.debug("Skipped selection: Expiration liquidation day.")
            return

        if self.is_pending_entry or (
            self.held_contract and self.portfolio[self.held_contract].invested
        ):
            self.debug("Skipped selection: Position or order already active.")
            return

        chain = slice.option_chains.get(self.option_symbol)
        if not chain:
            self.debug("Skipped selection: Option chain unavailable in slice.")
            return

        spy_price = self.securities[self.spy_symbol].price
        if spy_price <= 0:
            self.debug("Skipped selection: Invalid SPY price.")
            return

        current_date = self.time.date()

        # Filter for contracts with expiration >= 7 calendar days
        valid_expiries = [
            c.expiry.date()
            for c in chain
            if (c.expiry.date() - current_date).days >= 7
        ]
        if not valid_expiries:
            self.debug(
                "Skipped selection: No contracts with DTE >= 7 calendar days."
            )
            return

        nearest_expiry = min(valid_expiries)

        # Filter calls for nearest_expiry with strike >= 101% of current SPY price
        min_strike = 1.01 * spy_price
        eligible_calls = [
            c
            for c in chain
            if c.expiry.date() == nearest_expiry
            and c.right == OptionRight.CALL
            and c.strike >= min_strike
        ]

        if not eligible_calls:
            self.debug(
                f"Skipped selection: No call contracts with strike >= {min_strike:.2f} for expiry {nearest_expiry}."
            )
            return

        # Select lowest strike >= 101% OTM; tie-break by ascending symbol string
        selected_contract = sorted(
            eligible_calls, key=lambda c: (c.strike, str(c.symbol))
        )[0]

        # Submit market order for 1 contract
        self.is_pending_entry = True
        self.pending_contract_symbol = selected_contract.symbol
        self.market_order(selected_contract.symbol, 1)
        self.debug(
            f"Submitted entry market order for 1 contract of {selected_contract.symbol} (Strike: {selected_contract.strike}, Expiry: {selected_contract.expiry.date()})."
        )

    def on_order_event(self, order_event: OrderEvent) -> None:
        """Tracks fill events to set entry price accurately."""
        if order_event.status == OrderStatus.FILLED:
            # Entry order filled
            if (
                self.is_pending_entry
                and order_event.symbol == self.pending_contract_symbol
            ):
                if order_event.fill_quantity > 0:
                    self.held_contract = order_event.symbol
                    self.entry_price = order_event.fill_price
                    self.is_pending_entry = False
                    self.pending_contract_symbol = None
                    self.debug(
                        f"Entry order FILLED for {self.held_contract} at price {self.entry_price:.2f}"
                    )

            # Check for equity assignment position creation
            if (
                order_event.symbol == self.spy_symbol
                and self.portfolio[self.spy_symbol].invested
            ):
                self.debug(
                    "Unexpected SPY equity order fill detected. Liquidating SPY position immediately."
                )
                self.liquidate(self.spy_symbol)

        elif order_event.status in [
            OrderStatus.CANCELED,
            OrderStatus.INVALID,
            OrderStatus.REJECTED,
        ]:
            if (
                self.is_pending_entry
                and order_event.symbol == self.pending_contract_symbol
            ):
                self.debug(
                    f"Entry order failed/canceled: {order_event.message}"
                )
                self.is_pending_entry = False
                self.pending_contract_symbol = None

    def check_time_stop((self)) -> None:
        """Time stop scheduled at 15:45 NY time to liquidate on the trading day before expiry."""
        if self.held_contract and self.portfolio[self.held_contract].invested:
            current_date = self.time.date()
            expiry_date = self.held_contract.id.date.date()

            if self.is_preceding_trading_day(current_date, expiry_date):
                self.debug(
                    f"Time stop triggered at 15:45 NY time on {current_date} for contract expiring on {expiry_date}. Liquidating position."
                )
                self.liquidate(self.held_contract)
                self.held_contract = None
                self.entry_price = None

    def is_preceding_trading_day(
        self, current_date: datetime.date, expiry_date: datetime.date
    ) -> bool:
        """Returns True if current_date is the trading day immediately preceding expiry_date."""
        if current_date >= expiry_date:
            return True

        next_date = current_date + timedelta(days=1)
        while (
            next_date < expiry_date
            and not self.trading_calendar.get_trading_day(next_date).is_open
        ):
            next_date += timedelta(days=1)

        return next_date >= expiry_date

        if self.held_contract is not None and self.Portfolio[self.held_contract].Invested:
            expiry_date = self.held_contract.ID.Date.date()
            if self.IsPrecedingTradingDay(self.Time.date(), expiry_date):

                self.held_contract = None
                self.entry_price = None

        if current_date >= expiry_date:

        next_day = current_date + timedelta(days=1)
        trading_days = list(self.TradingCalendar.GetTradingDays(next_day, expiry_date))

        if len(open_days) == 0:
            return True
        if len(open_days) == 1 and open_days[0] == expiry_date:
            return True

        if slice.QuoteBars.ContainsKey(self.held_contract):

            if qb is not None and qb.Bid is not None and qb.Ask is not None:

        elif slice.OptionChains.ContainsKey(self.option_symbol):

                self.Debug(f"Profit Target Reached: Mid={mid:.2f} >= 1.50 * Entry({self.entry_price:.2f}). Liquidating {self.held_contract}")

        if len(open_days) == 0:

        if len(open_days) == 1 and open_days[0] == expiry_date:

            self.Debug(f"Entry Filled: {orderEvent.Symbol} at {orderEvent.FillPrice:.2f}")

class SPYOptionBullishCrossover(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)
        self.SetTimeZone(TimeZones.NewYork)

        # SPY Equity Data
        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.spy.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw)
        self.spy_symbol = self.spy.Symbol

        # SPY Option Data
        self.option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.option_symbol = self.option.Symbol
        self.option.SetFilter(self.OptionFilter)

        # Consolidator for 5-minute SPY TradeBars
        self.consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(timedelta(minutes=5))
        self.consolidator.DataConsolidated += self.OnFiveMinuteBar
        self.SubscriptionManager.AddConsolidator(self.spy_symbol, self.consolidator)

        # Moving Averages on 5-minute bars
        self.fast_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        # Internal state tracking
        self.prev_fast = None
        self.prev_slow = None
        self.crossover_signal = False

        self.held_option_symbol = None
        self.entry_order_id = None
        self.filled_entry_price = None

        self.skip_entries_today = False
        self.current_day = None

    def OptionFilter(self, universe):
        # Broad filter for Call options, >= 7 DTE, and strikes from ATM up to 20% OTM
        return universe.CallsOnly().Strikes(0, 40).Expiration(7, 60)

    def OnFiveMinuteBar(self, sender, bar):
        # Update SMAs with completed 5-minute SPY bar
        self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        if not (self.fast_sma.IsReady and self.slow_sma.IsReady):
            return

        # Check for bullish crossover on completed 5-minute bar
        if self.prev_fast is not None and self.prev_slow is not None:
            was_below_or_equal = self.prev_fast <= self.prev_slow
            is_above = self.fast_sma.Current.Value > self.slow_sma.Current.Value

            if was_below_or_equal and is_above:
                # Eligible window: bar EndTime from 09:45 through 14:30 NY time, inclusive
                bar_end_time = bar.EndTime.time()
                if time(9, 45) <= bar_end_time <= time(14, 30):
                    self.crossover_signal = True
                    self.Debug(f"Bullish crossover signal at {bar.EndTime}. Fast: {self.fast_sma.Current.Value:.2f}, Slow: {self.slow_sma.Current.Value:.2f}")

        self.prev_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
        self.prev_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

    def OnData(self, slice: Slice):
        # Reset daily entry lock on a new calendar day
        if self.Time.date() != self.current_day:
            self.current_day = self.Time.date()
            self.skip_entries_today = False

        # Safeguard: Liquidate unexpected SPY equity positions (exercise/assignment)
        if self.Portfolio[self.spy_symbol].Invested:
            self.Liquidate(self.spy_symbol)
            self.Debug(f"Unexpected SPY equity holding liquidated at {self.Time}.")

        # Cleanup internal tracking if position was closed
        if self.held_option_symbol is not None:
            if not self.Portfolio[self.held_option_symbol].Invested and not self.HasOpenEntryOrder():
                self.ResetPositionState()

        # Exit evaluation on each minute Slice for open option holdings
        if self.held_option_symbol is not None and self.Portfolio[self.held_option_symbol].Invested:
            self.EvaluateExits(slice)

        # Entry evaluation immediately following a signal
        if self.crossover_signal:
            self.crossover_signal = False  # Evaluate signal once immediately
            self.EvaluateEntry(slice)

    def EvaluateEntry(self, slice: Slice):
        if self.skip_entries_today:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped entry at {self.Time}: Entries paused for today due to prior expiration.")
            return

        if self.held_option_symbol is not None or self.HasOpenEntryOrder():
            self.Debug(f"Skipped entry at {self.Time}: Position already exists or entry order pending.")
            return

        chain = slice.OptionChains.GetValue(self.option_symbol)
        if chain is None or len(chain) == 0:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped entry at {self.Time}: No option chain delivered in current Slice.")
            return

        spy_price = self.Securities[self.spy_symbol].Price
        if spy_price <= 0:
            return

        min_strike = 1.01 * spy_price
        current_date = self.Time.date()

        # Filter candidate contracts
        valid_contracts = []
        for contract in chain:
            if contract.Right != OptionRight.Call:
                continue
            dte = (contract.Expiry.date() - current_date).days
            if dte < 7:
                continue
            if contract.Strike < min_strike:
                continue
            valid_contracts.append(contract)

        if not valid_contracts:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped entry at {self.Time}: No call contracts found matching >= 7 DTE and strike >= 101% SPY price.")
            return

        # Select nearest expiration whose calendar date is >= 7 days out
        nearest_expiry = min(c.Expiry.date() for c in valid_contracts)
        expiry_contracts = [c for c in valid_contracts if c.Expiry.date() == nearest_expiry]

        # Select lowest strike >= 101% of current SPY price; tie-break by ascending Symbol string
        min_strike_val = min(c.Strike for c in expiry_contracts)
        candidate_contracts = [c for c in expiry_contracts if c.Strike == min_strike_val]
        candidate_contracts.sort(key=lambda c: str(c.Symbol))

        selected_contract = candidate_contracts[0]

        # Submit market order for 1 contract
        order_ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected_contract.Symbol, 1)
        self.entry_order_id = order_ticket.OrderId
        self.held_option_symbol = selected_contract.Symbol
        self.Debug(f"Submitted entry market order for 1 contract of {selected_contract.Symbol} at {self.Time}.")

    def EvaluateExits(self, slice: Slice):
        symbol = self.held_option_symbol

        # Time Stop: 15:45 NY time on the trading day immediately preceding expiration date
        if self.IsPreExpirationTimeStop(symbol):
            self.Debug(f"Time stop triggered at 15:45 on pre-expiration day for {symbol}. Liquidating.")
            self.LiquidatePosition(symbol)
            return

        # Expiration safeguard: Liquidate if held into expiration date
        if self.Time.date() >= symbol.ID.Date.date():
            self.Debug(f"Expiration safeguard triggered for {symbol} at {self.Time}. Liquidating and disabling entries today.")
            self.skip_entries_today = True
            self.LiquidatePosition(symbol)
            return

        # Profit Target: 50% profit based on midpoint of strictly positive bid and ask
        security = self.Securities[symbol]
        bid = security.BidPrice
        ask = security.AskPrice

        if bid > 0 and ask > 0 and self.filled_entry_price is not None and self.filled_entry_price > 0:
            midpoint = (bid + ask) / 2.0
            if midpoint >= 1.50 * self.filled_entry_price:
                self.Debug(f"Profit target (50%) reached for {symbol} at {self.Time}: Midpoint={midpoint:.2f}, EntryFill={self.filled_entry_price:.2f}. Liquidating.")
                self.LiquidatePosition(symbol)

    def IsPreExpirationTimeStop(self, option_symbol) -> bool:
        if self.Time.hour != 15 or self.Time.minute != 45:
            return False

        expiry_date = option_symbol.ID.Date.date()
        current_date = self.Time.date()

        if current_date >= expiry_date:
            return False

        # Find trading days between current date and expiration date
        trading_days = [
            td.Date.date() for td in self.TradingCalendar.GetTradingDays(current_date, expiry_date)
            if td.IsOpen and td.Date.date() < expiry_date
        ]

        if trading_days:
            pre_exp_trading_day = max(trading_days)
            return current_date == pre_exp_trading_day

        return False

    def LiquidatePosition(self, symbol):
        self.Transactions.CancelOpenOrders(symbol)
        self.MarketOrder(symbol, -self.Portfolio[symbol].Quantity)
        self.ResetPositionState()

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent: OrderEvent):

        if not trading_days:

from AlgorithmImports import *
from datetime import timedelta, time

class SPYOptionCrossoverAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        # Set backtest parameters
        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)
        self.SetTimeZone("America/New_York")

        # Subscribe to SPY raw-priced equity minute data
        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.spy.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw)
        self.spy_symbol = self.spy.Symbol

        # Subscribe to SPY options minute data with broad universe filter
        option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        option.SetFilter(self.OptionFilterFunction)
        self.option_symbol = option.Symbol

        # Define 5-bar and 20-bar Simple Moving Averages for 5-minute bars
        self.fast_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        # Consolidate minute TradeBars into 5-minute TradeBars aligned to New York clock boundaries
        self.consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(timedelta(minutes=5))
        self.consolidator.DataConsolidated += self.OnFiveMinuteBar
        self.SubscriptionManager.AddConsolidator(self.spy_symbol, self.consolidator)

        # Track algorithm state
        self.held_contract = None
        self.entry_price = None
        self.entry_order_id = None
        self.is_entry_pending = False
        self.is_exit_pending = False
        self.no_new_entries_today = False

        # Daily schedule to reset daily restrictions at market open
        self.Schedule.On(
            self.DateRules.EveryDay("SPY"),
            self.TimeRules.AfterMarketOpen("SPY", 0),
            self.ResetDailyState
        )

    def OptionFilterFunction(self, universe):
        # Select call options with 7 to 60 days to expiration and relative strike range
        return universe.CallsOnly().Strikes(-2, 50).Expiration(7, 60)

    def ResetDailyState(self):
        self.no_new_entries_today = False

    def OnFiveMinuteBar(self, sender, bar):
        # Store SMA values prior to updating with the newly closed 5-minute bar
        prev_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value if self.fast_sma.IsReady else None
        prev_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value if self.slow_sma.IsReady else None

        # Update SMAs with the 5-minute bar closing price
        self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        # Both averages must be ready before testing signal
        if not (self.fast_sma.IsReady and self.slow_sma.IsReady):
            return

        if prev_fast is None or prev_slow is None:
            return

        curr_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
        curr_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        # Check for bullish crossover
        is_crossover = (prev_fast <= prev_slow) and (curr_fast > curr_slow)
        if not is_crossover:
            return

        # Check entry time window: bar ends from 09:45 through 14:30 NY time, inclusive
        bar_time = bar.EndTime.time()
        if not (time(9, 45) <= bar_time <= time(14, 30)):
            return

        # Ensure no existing position, pending entry order, or daily entry restriction
        if self.held_contract is not None or self.is_entry_pending or self.no_new_entries_today:
            return

        if any(sec.Invested and sec.Type == SecurityType.Option for sec in self.Portfolio.Values):
            return

        # Evaluate contract selection and place entry order
        self.TryEnterPosition()

    def TryEnterPosition(self):
        if self.CurrentSlice is None:
            self.Debug("Skipped selection: CurrentSlice is None")
            return

        contracts = []
        if self.CurrentSlice.OptionChains is not None:
            for chain in self.CurrentSlice.OptionChains.Values:
                for contract in chain:
                    contracts.append(contract)

        if not contracts:
            self.Debug("Skipped selection: OptionChains is empty in CurrentSlice")
            return

        current_date = self.Time.date()

        # Filter call contracts
        call_contracts = [c for c in contracts if c.Right == OptionRight.Call]
        if not call_contracts:
            self.Debug("Skipped selection: No call contracts in current Slice")
            return

        # Filter contracts with expiration date at least 7 calendar days after current date
        valid_expirations = [c for c in call_contracts if (c.Expiry.date() - current_date).days >= 7]
        if not valid_expirations:
            self.Debug("Skipped selection: No call contracts with DTE >= 7 calendar days")
            return

        # Select nearest expiration
        nearest_expiry_date = min(c.Expiry.date() for c in valid_expirations)
        expiry_contracts = [c for c in valid_expirations if c.Expiry.date() == nearest_expiry_date]

        # Get underlying SPY price
        if not self.Securities.ContainsKey(self.spy_symbol):
            return
        spy_price = self.Securities[self.spy_symbol].Price
        if spy_price <= 0:
            self.Debug("Skipped selection: SPY price unavailable or nonpositive")
            return

        target_strike = 1.01 * spy_price

        # Select lowest strike >= 101% of current SPY price
        eligible_contracts = [c for c in expiry_contracts if c.Strike >= target_strike]
        if not eligible_contracts:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped selection: No call contract with strike >= 101% SPY price ({target_strike:.2f})")
            return

        # Sort by ascending strike, breaking ties by ascending Symbol string
        eligible_contracts.sort(key=lambda c: (c.Strike, str(c.Symbol)))
        selected_contract = eligible_contracts[0]

        # Submit market order for 1 contract
        ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected_contract.Symbol, 1)
        self.entry_order_id = ticket.OrderId
        self.is_entry_pending = True
        self.Debug(f"ENTRY ORDER SUBMITTED: {selected_contract.Symbol}, Strike: {selected_contract.Strike}, Expiry: {selected_contract.Expiry.date()}, SPY: {spy_price:.2f}")

    def OnData(self, slice):
        # Handle unexpected SPY equity position created by exercise or assignment
        if self.Portfolio[self.spy_symbol].Invested:
            self.Liquidate(self.spy_symbol)
            self.no_new_entries_today = True
            self.Debug("UNEXPECTED EQUITY: Liquidated SPY equity position from exercise/assignment.")

        if self.held_contract is None:
            return

        holding = self.Portfolio.get(self.held_contract)
        if holding is None or not holding.Invested:
            return

        current_time = self.Time
        expiry_date = self.held_contract.ID.Date.date()

        # Expiration safety exit: liquidate if position reaches or passes expiration date
        if current_time.date() >= expiry_date:
            if not self.is_exit_pending:
                self.Liquidate(self.held_contract)
                self.is_exit_pending = True
                self.no_new_entries_today = True
                self.Debug(f"EXPIRATION SAFETY EXIT: Liquidated {self.held_contract} on/after expiration date {expiry_date}")
            return

        # Scheduled Time Stop: 15:45 NY time on the trading day immediately preceding contract expiration
        preceding_trading_day = self.GetPrecedingTradingDay(expiry_date)
        if current_time.date() == preceding_trading_day and current_time.hour == 15 and current_time.minute >= 45:
            if not self.is_exit_pending:
                self.Liquidate(self.held_contract)
                self.is_exit_pending = True
                self.Debug(f"TIME STOP EXIT: Liquidated {self.held_contract} at 15:45 on preceding trading day {preceding_trading_day}")
            return

        # 50% Profit Target test based on midpoint of strictly positive bid and ask
        if self.entry_price is not None and self.entry_price > 0:
            mid_price = self.GetCurrentSliceMidPrice(slice, self.held_contract)
            if mid_price is not None:
                if mid_price >= 1.50 * self.entry_price:
                    if not self.is_exit_pending:
                        self.Transactions.CancelOpenOrders(self.held_contract)
                        self.Liquidate(self.held_contract)
                        self.is_exit_pending = True

        option.set_filter(lambda universe: universe.calls_only().expiration(7, 60).strikes(-2, 20))

        # Consolidate 5-minute bars aligned to NY clock boundaries (09:30-09:35 is the first session bar)
        self.consolidate(self.spy_symbol, timedelta(minutes=5), self.on_five_minute_bar)

        # Moving Averages (5-bar fast SMA, 20-bar slow SMA on 5-minute closing prices)
        self.fast_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        self.prev_fast = None
        self.prev_slow = None

        # State tracking
        self.entry_order_ticket = None
        self.exit_order_ticket = None
        self.held_option_symbol = None
        self.entry_price = None
        self.expiration_no_trade_date = None

    def on_five_minute_bar(self, bar: TradeBar) -> None:

        Handler for completed 5-minute SPY TradeBars.

        """

        self.fast_sma.update(bar.end_time, bar.close)
        self.slow_sma.update(bar.end_time, bar.close)

        # Both averages must be ready before testing signal
        if not self.fast_sma.is_ready or not self.slow_sma.is_ready:
            self.prev_fast = self.fast_sma.current.value
            self.prev_slow = self.slow_sma.current.value
            return

        current_fast = self.fast_sma.current.value
        current_slow = self.slow_sma.current.value

        # Bullish crossover: fast <= slow on preceding bar AND fast > slow on current bar
        bullish_crossover = False
        if self.prev_fast is not None and self.prev_slow is not None:
            bullish_crossover = (self.prev_fast <= self.prev_slow) and (current_fast > current_slow)

        # Update previous bar values for the next evaluation
        self.prev_fast = current_fast
        self.prev_slow = current_slow

        if bullish_crossover:
            # Check entry time window: bar ends from 09:45 through 14:30 NY time, inclusive
            bar_end_time = bar.end_time.time()
            if time(9, 45) <= bar_end_time <= time(14, 30):
                self.evaluate_entry()

    def evaluate_entry(self) -> None:
        """
        Selects and orders 1 call contract if all entry rules are met.
        """
        # Do not submit entry if an option holding exists or an entry/exit order is open
        if self.has_open_position_or_order():
            self.debug(f"[{self.time}] Entry skipped: Existing position or pending order.")
            return

        # Do not open replacement position on a date an expiration liquidation occurred
        if self.expiration_no_trade_date == self.time.date():
            self.debug(f"[{self.time}] Entry skipped: Expiration liquidation already occurred today.")
            return

        # Inspect current option chain
        if self.current_slice is None or not self.current_slice.option_chains.contains_key(self.option_symbol):
            self.debug(f"[{self.time}] Entry skipped: Option chain data not available in current slice.")
            return

        chain = self.current_slice.option_chains[self.option_symbol]
        current_date = self.time.date()

        # Filter calls with calendar days to expiration >= 7
        eligible_calls = [
            c for c in chain
            if c.right == OptionRight.CALL and (c.expiry.date() - current_date).days >= 7
        ]

        if not eligible_calls:
            self.debug(f"[{self.time}] Entry skipped: No call contracts with DTE >= 7 calendar days.")
            return

        # Nearest expiration whose calendar date is >= 7 days after current algorithm date
        min_dte = min((c.expiry.date() - current_date).days for c in eligible_calls)
        target_expiry_contracts = [c for c in eligible_calls if (c.expiry.date() - current_date).days == min_dte]

        # Current SPY price
        spy_price = self.securities[self.spy_symbol].price
        if spy_price <= 0:
            self.debug(f"[{self.time}] Entry skipped: Invalid SPY price ({spy_price}).")
            return

        valid_strike_contracts = [c for c in target_expiry_contracts if c.strike >= strike_floor]
